Coram : AR. LAKSHMANAN*, ALTAMAS KABIR
Industrial Disputes Act, 1947-ss.2(00) & 25F-Appointmentfor specific period on specified honorarium-Termination of services on expiry of such C specific period-Held, does not amount to retrenchment-Since appointment was only on contract basis. Respondent was engaged under a time bound specific on a specified honorarium. D The question which arose for consideration in the present appeal is whether Respondent was not a worker for purposes ofS.25F of the Industrial Disputes Act, 194.7 but was employed on contract basis for a specific period and hence cannot be said to have been retrenched
Decision Date : 16-11-2006 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3251/2005 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
